description: Advises on naming a branch for a piece of work. Use when the user asks what to call a branch or whether a branch name is good.
---

# Branch names

1. Read what the work is about from the conversation or the ticket the user named.
2. Name the branch after the change it carries, in lowercase words joined by hyphens,
   the way [names.md](references/names.md) shows.
